budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Maintain and trade between four settlements while choosing resource investments, levee/culvert routing, raised roads and shared flood responses during a persistent 20x20 interaction window.
task.natural_termination: No single settlement quest ends this persistent strategy world. terminated remains false and tick 384 truncates; harvest, trade, construction and flood losses never reset the state.
task.interaction: Levees and closed culverts divert physical packets toward neighboring fields. Roads allow deep-water crossings and faster hauling but degrade in severe water. Grain trade and material gifts change other settlements' future construction/food options; dated reports require physical inspection or adjacent transfer.
task.observation_access: Public information consists of clock/terminal causes, rain, aggregate flood-alert count, settlement coordinates and fixed food valuations. Each worker sees map cells, peers and water packets within Manhattan radius four; hidden map/entity records are -1 with a visibility bit. Own settlement stores/field water are continuously available as its explicit home telemetry; other settlement contents require local visibility. Each actor additionally sees its own dated report memory and six reward components. Public safety rewards and the alerts counter reveal only the aggregate exposed-settlement count, not remote identities or crop/store values. The scene map uses the actual map_visible mask.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public number of settlements with field depth >=2; identities remain local

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
